body.text:
# busbar <VERSION> config, migrated by `busbar --migrate-config`.
# The items below need a decision; `busbar --validate` must pass.
# TODO(migrate): auth.chain: the static-token allowlist is GONE in 1.5.0; every caller needs a minted signed key (POST /api/v1/admin/keys) - 1.x bearer tokens stop working
# TODO(migrate): auth.client_tokens removed: static tokens are gone in 1.5.0; mint signed keys for each caller (POST /api/v1/admin/keys)

listen: 0.0.0.0:8080
pools:
  haiku:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
  fast:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
    - model: gpt-4o-mini
  balanced:
    members:
    - weight: 8
      model: claude-sonnet
    - weight: 2
      model: gpt-4o
  long-context:
    members:
    - context_max: 200000
      model: claude-sonnet
    - context_max: 2000000
      model: gemini-1.5-pro
  resilient:
    members:
    - weight: 3
      model: claude-sonnet
    - weight: 2
      model: gpt-4o
    - weight: 1
      model: glm-4.6
    failover:
      exclusions:
      - glm-4.6
      timeout_secs: 30
      max_hops: 3
  primary:
    members:
    - model: claude-sonnet
    - model: gpt-4o
    on_exhausted:
      fallback_pool: overflow
  overflow:
    members:
    - model: claude-haiku
    - model: gpt-4o-mini
    - model: glm-4.6
    on_exhausted: least_bad
  smart:
    members:
    - weight: 2
      model: claude-sonnet
    - weight: 2
      model: gpt-4o
    - weight: 1
      model: gemini-1.5-pro
    affinity:
      mode: session
      header_name: x-session-id
providers:
  anthropic:
    api_key:
      env: ANTHROPIC_KEY
  openai:
    api_key:
      env: OPENAI_KEY
  gemini:
    api_key:
      env: GEMINI_KEY
  z.ai:
    api_key:
      env: ZAI_KEY
  bedrock:
    api_key:
      env: AWS_BEDROCK_CREDS
models:
  claude-sonnet:
    provider: anthropic
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
  claude-haiku:
    provider: anthropic
    max_concurrent: 40
    max_requests: -1
  gpt-4o:
    provider: openai
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
  gpt-4o-mini:
    provider: openai
    max_concurrent: 50
    max_requests: -1
  gemini-1.5-pro:
    provider: gemini
    max_concurrent: 15
    max_requests: -1
  glm-4.6:
    provider: z.ai
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
  claude-sonnet-bedrock:
    provider: bedrock
    max_concurrent: 20
    max_requests: -1
auth:
  chain:
  - keys
